description: Classificazione sismica dei comuni italiani 2020 (RNDT-Dataset) - Versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by protezionecivile.it. Order No 3274 of the President of the Council of Ministers of 20 March 2003, in Official Gazette No 105 of 8 May 2003, lays down the general principles on the basis of which the Regions, to which the State has delegated the adoption of the seismic classification of the territory (Legislative Decree No 112 ... Its keywords include seismic zonation, hazard, OpenData. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
